text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Weeell, then! It's about time to head to 
training!

text_block_list.name: TV Host
text_block_list.text:
"The series 'Honing Your Talent'… will 
provide you with plenty of useful 
information throughout the night!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oya!? Isn't this TV show the legendary 
series of must-see honors students!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
However… throughout the night. Right then, 
I'll just have to do training another ti… 
But……

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
No, nonono! I'm brilliant! I can make up 
for lost practice in no time!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
This is the only time I can watch this 
show! Because I can never get it back…!

This is how Sakura Bakushin O got so 
caught up in her TV show that she 
neglected her training.
